deep.reconstruction:
This page holds no mathematics. It is a short excerpt, in Riemann's hand, copied from Herbart's Sämmtliche Werke, vol. V, p. 446. In Hartenstein's edition, vol. V–VI is 'Psychologie als Wissenschaft'; the exact section is not identified here. The passage is Herbart's account of how a presentation (Vorstellung) is placed in 'series' (Reihen) through associative links.

In paraphrase: when a presentation first arises, it enters several series at once. It links (i) to the presentations already in consciousness, (ii) to presentations given at the same time, and (iii) to presentations whose reproduction it triggers immediately afterward. The reproduced presentations had themselves formed such links earlier, more or less often. So the third kind of link carries many further determinations that can be mediated gradually. Through the first kind a presentation gets a place in time, through the second a place in space, and through the third a place in the realm of concepts.

Context: the next page, an editor's draft introduction (presumably Dedekind or Weber) to Riemann's 'Fragmente philosophischen Inhalts', quotes Riemann calling himself a Herbartian in psychology and epistemology. This excerpt is reading material behind that stance, and behind Riemann's own psychological fragments on the association of Vorstellungen and the origin of spatial and temporal order. A loose link to Riemann's concern with how 'multiply extended magnitudes' and spatial order arise in thought (Habilitationsvortrag) is plausible but speculative. No derivation exists to reconstruct.

results.what: Excerpt of Herbart's associationist theory: three kinds of linkage of presentations (with prior contents of consciousness, with simultaneous ones, with those reproduced) yield placement in time, in space, and in the realm of concepts
results.modern_name: Herbartian associationist psychology / psychological genesis of space-time order

deep.surprise_reason: This is a reading excerpt copied from Herbart. Riemann's Herbartianism in psychology is well known: he says so himself in notes printed in the Gesammelte Werke. The page contains no mathematics and no original result.
transcription_corrections: Line 1: the image reads 'Herbart W. V. p. 446.', i.e. Werke vol. V p. 446. This is the Hartenstein edition volume containing 'Psychologie als Wissenschaft'.
'seltener oder öfter Verbindungen[?]': the image supports 'Verbindungen' with fair confidence.

'mannigfaltige[?] unserer Begriffsbestimmungen[?]': the image is hard to read here. 'mancherlei' is a likely alternative to 'mannigfaltige', and the noun could be 'Bestimmungen' or 'Begriffsbestimmungen'. Check against Herbart's printed text, vol. V p. 446.
'Geht man die reproducirten weiter nach[?]': possibly 'weiter durch' or 'weiter nach'; the sense is unaffected.
Final line: 'vermöge der zweiten einen Ort im Raume; vermöge der dritten einen Platz im Reiche der Begriffe' is confirmed by the image.
